item.title: United Cup: Spain Meet Argentina; Greece Face Japan On Opening Day In Perth
item.description: Ken Rosewall Arena: Jaume Munar will take on Sebastian Baez in the men's singles, while Jéssica Bouzas Maneiro will play Solana Sierra in the women's singles when Spain kick off their campaign against Argentina in the United Cup mixed team tennis competition in Perth on Friday.

item.title: Vimath Dinsara To Lead Sri Lanka In 2026 U19 Men’s Cricket World Cup
item.description: Cricket World Cup: Vimath Dinsara will captain Sri Lanka in the 2026 Under-19 Men's Cricket World Cup, Sri Lanka Cricket (SLC) said on Thursday. Kavija Gamage has been named as Sri Lanka’s vice-captain for the tournament beginning on January 15 in Zimbabwe and Namibia.

item.title: Norwich City Overcome Queens Park Rangers, Start 2026 With Victory In Championship
item.description: Queens Park Rangers: Norwich City began 2026 with a win, claiming a 2-1 victory away to Queens Park Rangers on New Year's Day in the Championship. Josh Sargent scored the opening goal soon after the start of the second half before Jovon Makama doubled the lead in the sixth minute of added time before Amadou Mbengue reduced the margin in the 9th minute after regulation time in a frantic finish to the match.

item.title: Usman Khawaja To Retire From International Cricket After Sydney Ashes Test
item.description: Shane Warne Test Cricketer: Veteran Australia batter Usman Khawaja announced on Friday that he will retire from international cricket after the fifth Ashes Test against England at the Sydney Cricket Ground.

item.title: Football Transfer Watch: Villa Restart Pursuit Of Newcastle's Struggling William Osule
item.description: Aston Villa: Aston Villa have made a move to sign Newcastle United striker William Osula in their first major trade in the January transfer window as manager Unai Emery looks to bring in attacking reinforcements to strengthen the squad in the second half of the English season, media reports said on Thursday.

item.title: Numbers Don’t Lie: Yashasvi Jaiswal’s Case for the T20 World Cup 2026
item.description: Yashasvi Jaiswal’s omission from India’s T20 World Cup 2026 squad raises questions, despite his outstanding numbers, consistency across formats, and proven match-winning impact.

item.title: Premier League: Man City Held To Goalless Draw At Sunderland
item.description: Premier League: Manchester City started the new calendar year with a 0-0 draw at Sunderland’s Stadium of Light. Pep Guardiola’s side missed their opportunity to move back within two points of the Gunners, following the entertaining stalemate.

item.title: 'Still Have To Fight Every Single Day': Khawaja Calls Out Racial Stereotypes In Australian Cricket
item.description: Multicultural Action Plan: Retiring veteran batter Usman Khawaja has hit out at racial stereotypes in Australian cricket, claiming he has been treated differently across his career because of his race and religion.

item.title: Venus Williams Receives 2026 Australian Open Wild Card
item.description: Mubadala Citi DC Open: Seven-time Grand Slam champion Venus Williams received a wild card entry into the main draw at the 2026 Australian Open.

item.title: J&K; Police Summons Cricketer For Displaying Palestine Flag During Local Match
item.description: Furqan Bhat: The J&K Police said on Friday that they have summoned a local cricketer for displaying the Palestinian flag on his cap during a local match.
